ex.en: My son is engaged to his secretary.
ex.zh: 我的兒子和他的秘書訂婚了。

ex.en: She is engaged to a rich man.
ex.zh: 她和一個有錢人訂了婚。

ex.en: He got engaged to my cousin.
ex.zh: 他和我的堂姊妹訂婚了。

ex.en: My father has been engaged in foreign trade for many years.
ex.zh: 我父親從事外貿多年。

ex.en: They are engaged in cancer research.
ex.zh: 他們從事癌症研究工作。

ex.en: All entrees come with a salad.
ex.zh: 所有主菜都附沙拉。

ex.en: I'll have the fish as my entree.
ex.zh: 我主菜要點魚。

ex.en: The athlete earns millions from endorsements.
ex.zh: 那位運動員靠代言賺了數百萬。

ex.en: Celebrity endorsements can boost sales.
ex.zh: 名人代言可以提升銷量。

ex.en: A translation is not an endorsement.
ex.zh: 翻譯不代表認同。

ex.en: The plan received the endorsement of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得董事會的支持。

ex.en: They entertained us at dinner last night.
ex.zh: 他們昨晚請我們吃晚餐。

ex.en: We often entertain clients at this restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們常在這家餐廳招待客戶。

ex.en: He entertained us with jokes all evening.
ex.zh: 他整晚講笑話逗我們開心。

ex.en: The clown entertained the children.
ex.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們很開心。

ex.en: Please wait for me at the entrance of the building.
ex.zh: 請在建築的入口處等我。

ex.en: Some people were hanging around at the entrance.
ex.zh: 有些人在入口處停留。

ex.en: Because the entrance was locked, we couldn't enter the house.
ex.zh: 因為門口鎖住了，我們進不了屋子。

ex.en: I hear you passed the entrance exam. Congratulations!
ex.zh: 我聽說你通過了入學考試。恭喜你了！

ex.en: He is busy preparing for the entrance examination.
ex.zh: 他忙著準備入學考試。

ex.en: Entry is strictly for staff only.
ex.zh: 僅限工作人員進入。

ex.en: Disregarding the "No Entry" sign, she pushed open the door and walked inside.
ex.zh: 她不理會「禁止進入」的牌子，推開門走了進去。

ex.en: This dictionary has about 40,000 entries.
ex.zh: 這本字典大約有四萬個詞條。

ex.en: I made an entry in my diary every night.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上都會寫一篇日記。

ex.en: She sent me the enclosed check.
ex.zh: 她把隨信附上的支票寄給了我。

ex.en: Please find the enclosed contract.
ex.zh: 隨函附上合約，請查收。
